description.value: The Nisg̱aʼa Museum in Lax̱g̱altsʼap (Greenville) is the official cultural institution of the Nisg̱aʼa Nation, housing ancestral regalia, art, and historical artifacts returned to the community. Designed by Hillel Architecture, the building itself is architecturally significant and sits within Nisg̱aʼa Lands in the remote Nass Valley of northwestern BC. For touring cyclists venturing into this rarely visited region, it offers a compelling cultural destination at the end of a long ride.
